title: Stacksmith Stack Definition
description: Defines a single infrastructure stack for stacksmith.

name.description: Unique stack identifier within the monorepo.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the stack's purpose.

tags.description: Arbitrary tags for filtering, CI targeting, and documentation. e.g. [platform, prod]

depends_on.description: List of stack names that must be applied before this stack. Terragrunt reads their declared root outputs while resolving the dependency graph.

description.description: Optional human-readable description emitted on the root OpenTofu output.

value.description: Exported value. May contain deferred references to managed public component outputs.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the stack output transform.

jinja.description: Jinja template applied during generation with `output.value` and `output.name` in scope.

transform.description: Optional safe Jinja transform applied after component output binding.

sensitive.description: Whether OpenTofu should mark this root output as sensitive.

mock.description: Optional pre-transform mock value used by dependent stacks during plan and validate before this stack has been applied.

outputs.description: Explicit root outputs exported by this stack for dependent stacks and external consumers.

type.description: Abstract component type that maps to a module in the tool configuration.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this component instance.

tags.description: Optional tags used for tag-expression targeting.

properties.description: Properties passed as inputs to the module. Values may contain Jinja expressions, including deferred references to managed public component outputs.

components.description: Component definitions. Keys are component names, values specify type and properties.

use.description: Name of an operation approved in the tool configuration.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this operation invocation.

with.description: Declared operation inputs. Values may contain Jinja expressions, including deferred references to managed public component outputs.

rerun_token.description: Optional value that deliberately creates a new operation execution identity.

depends_on.description: Stack-local operations that must succeed before this operation runs.

operations.description: Native operational actions requested by this stack.
